# Warehouse Management Web Application

This is a React-based warehouse management system with Firebase authentication and real-time database.

## Project Requirements
- Admin dashboard with inventory management
- Dispatch user role with limited permissions
- Photo upload for products
- Statistics and analytics
- Responsive UI
- Deployed on Netlify with Firebase backend

## Setup Checklist

- [ ] Verify copilot-instructions.md exists
- [ ] Scaffold React project with Firebase setup
- [ ] Customize project structure and components
- [ ] Install required dependencies
- [ ] Configure Firebase credentials
- [ ] Create and run development server
- [ ] Ensure README.md is complete
